headline: A cleaner site, creative audio filters, no subscriptions, and a professional finishing layout
notes: The top menu box: Products, Download, Pricing and Help, with the same links in a proper drawer on a phone.
A section rail down the right-hand edge that marks where you are as you scroll, with a progress line under the menu.
17 creative audio filters — underwater, telephone, old radio, megaphone, cathedral, vinyl, robot, 8-bit, nightcore and more. Thirteen are free.
Subscriptions are gone. Every edition is one payment: nothing renews, nothing expires, nothing to cancel.
AI editing now starts at Creator. Everything that runs on your own device — including the one-tap edit styles that build a whole edit — stays free.
Professional replaces Expert: a finishing-suite layout with tighter rows, tabular figures and a neutral grey chrome.
Sliders no longer rebuild the panel under your finger, and keyboard focus survives an edit.
The offline app now caches every module, so audio repair, codecs, bundles and proxies work on a cold start with no signal.
